_doc: The heroine's lines (session 7). Source of truth for tools/voice/gen_voice.mjs (ElevenLabs v3, build time) and src/audio/Dialogue.ts. text = subtitle; tts = what the voice model reads (audio tags in [brackets], phonetic names). priority: 5 story/boss/discovery, 4 tutorial/objective/hint, 3 combat, 2 flavour, 1 idle. pool = lines that share a trigger (one is picked, never the same twice running). See docs/DIALOGUE.md.

lines.text: That gate was whole, for a heartbeat. If my blood came from here, so will my answers.
lines.tts: [quietly] That gate was whole... for a heartbeat. If my blood came from here, so will my answers.

lines.text: Rusted solid. The wall to the east has broken through.
lines.tts: Rusted solid. The wall to the east has broken through.

lines.text: A way in. That'll do.
lines.tts: A way in. [dryly] That'll do.

lines.text: Echoes. Grandmother called them Echoes. I thought it was a story.
lines.tts: [tense] Echoes. Grandmother called them Echoes... I thought it was a story.

lines.text: It went into me. Into my blood.
lines.tts: [gasps] It went into me. Into my blood.

lines.text: The crest we kept all those years. Drawn here in blood.
lines.tts: The crest we kept, all those years... drawn here in blood.

lines.text: It knows me. The whole castle just listened.
lines.tts: [whispers] It knows me. The whole castle just... listened.

lines.text: The gate remembers being open. Stand before it, hold on, and pull.
lines.tts: The gate remembers being open. Stand before it, hold on... and pull.

lines.text: It's whole. Torches, banners — people.
lines.tts: [breathless] It's whole. Torches, banners... people.

lines.text: They think I'm the intruder.
lines.tts: They think I'm the intruder.

lines.text: Not enough. I need what the Echoes carry.
lines.tts: Not enough. I need what the Echoes carry.

lines.text: Solid stone, in that memory. Not here.
lines.tts: Solid stone, in that memory. Not here.

lines.text: Nothing to stand on, in that memory.
lines.tts: Nothing to stand on, in that memory.

lines.text: Blood on stone. It remembers me now.
lines.tts: Blood on stone. It remembers me now.

lines.text: Another mark of the old line.
lines.tts: Another mark of the old line.

lines.text: A breath. Then onward.
lines.tts: [exhales] A breath. Then onward.

lines.text: Hold this place for me.
lines.tts: Hold this place for me.

lines.text: Even up here, they bled for the stone.
lines.tts: Even up here, they bled for the stone.

lines.text: Close now. I can feel it under my feet.
lines.tts: Close now. I can feel it under my feet.

lines.text: The walls remember.
lines.tts: The walls remember.

lines.text: Back to the ruin.
lines.tts: [quietly] Back to the ruin.

lines.text: Their last night, again.
lines.tts: Their last night... again.

lines.text: Every time, it pulls harder.
lines.tts: Every time, it pulls harder.

lines.text: It isn't time. It's the castle, choosing what to remember.
lines.tts: It isn't time. It's the castle... choosing what to remember.

lines.text: It barely holds still now.
lines.tts: It barely holds still now.

lines.text: Wrong memory to be in.
lines.tts: [tense] Wrong memory to be in.

lines.text: Closed from the inside? Who were they keeping in?
lines.tts: [uneasy] Closed... from the inside? Who were they keeping in?

lines.text: They packed to leave. Someone turned them back.
lines.tts: They packed to leave. Someone turned them back.

lines.text: Barricaded against their own king's wardens.
lines.tts: [quietly] Barricaded... against their own king's wardens.

lines.text: They didn't die holding the door. It was broken in.
lines.tts: They didn't die holding the door. It was broken in.

lines.text: Sealed by Royal Order. Everything here was.
lines.tts: Sealed by Royal Order. Everything here was.

lines.text: The racks are empty. Armed for what, then?
lines.tts: The racks are empty. Armed for what, then?

lines.text: It doesn't know me. Then why does the rest of it?
lines.tts: It doesn't know me. [quietly] Then why does the rest of it?

lines.text: Someone ran west and barred it behind them.
lines.tts: Someone ran west, and barred it behind them.

lines.text: Sealed again. Of course.
lines.tts: [sighs] Sealed again. Of course.

lines.text: Commoners, kneeling to a royal rite. Under guard.
lines.tts: Commoners, kneeling to a royal rite. Under guard.

lines.text: Aldren. The last king. And his tomb is empty.
lines.tts: Aldren. The last king... and his tomb is empty.

lines.text: They dug toward that light. On the king's orders. Whatever broke this castle came from inside it.
lines.tts: They dug toward that light... on the king's orders. [uneasy] Whatever broke this castle came from inside it.

lines.text: Paperwork. They sealed people in with paperwork.
lines.tts: Paperwork. They sealed people in... with paperwork.

lines.text: Eleven wardens refused. Eleven names struck out.
lines.tts: Eleven wardens refused. Eleven names, struck out.

lines.text: A girl, not of his line, taken down the servants' stair. Unmarked. Like me.
lines.tts: [shaken] A girl, not of his line... taken down the servants' stair. [quietly] Unmarked. Like me.

lines.text: 'Every stone, every soul.' He did this. My own blood did this.
lines.tts: Every stone... every soul. [angry] He did this. My own blood did this.

lines.text: A crown of candles, lowered every night for his hand.
lines.tts: A crown of candles... lowered every night, for his hand.

lines.text: Still doesn't know me.
lines.tts: Still doesn't know me.

lines.text: The bell was waiting for a king who never came back up.
lines.tts: The bell was waiting for a king who never came back up.

lines.text: An empty plinth, for the one who'd keep Veyr forever. He meant himself.
lines.tts: An empty plinth, for the one who'd keep Vair forever. [bitterly] He meant himself.

lines.text: Barricaded from inside. But in the ruin, that door was broken in.
lines.tts: Barricaded from inside. But in the ruin, that door was broken in.

lines.text: The rubble reaches the landing. The stair still stands in the other memory.
lines.tts: The rubble reaches the landing. The stair still stands... in the other memory.

lines.text: Barred from the far side. In the ruin the roof came down here. Maybe I can crawl under.
lines.tts: Barred from the far side. In the ruin the roof came down here... maybe I can crawl under.

lines.text: Choked with rubble now. In their time, that door stood open.
lines.tts: Choked with rubble now. In their time, that door stood open.

lines.text: The floor gave way here, in the ruin. That's my way down.
lines.tts: The floor gave way here, in the ruin. That's my way down.

lines.text: The scaffold rotted away. In the old memory, it still climbs to the hatch.
lines.tts: The scaffold rotted away. In the old memory, it still climbs to the hatch.

lines.text: Only the doorway stands in both memories. I have to be inside it.
lines.tts: Only the doorway stands in both memories. I have to be inside it.

lines.text: The Chancery door is buried here. Not in their time.
lines.tts: The Chancery door is buried here. Not in their time.

lines.text: In the ruin, the mezzanine sags down to that door. I need to be up there.
lines.tts: In the ruin, the mezzanine sags down to that door. I need to be up there.

lines.text: Rusted shut. But the fallen roof climbs right past it.
lines.tts: Rusted shut. But the fallen roof climbs right past it.

lines.text: The gallery still stands in the old memory.
lines.tts: The gallery still stands, in the old memory.

lines.text: That winch holds the whole chandelier. If it gave way...
lines.tts: That winch holds the whole chandelier. If it gave way...

lines.text: The crown still hangs in their time. I need it down here, across the gap.
lines.tts: The crown still hangs in their time. I need it down here, across the gap.

lines.text: The stair only stands in the old memory.
lines.tts: The stair only stands in the old memory.

lines.text: The floor's gone here. It wasn't, before.
lines.tts: The floor's gone here. It wasn't, before.

lines.text: Their gate still stands. In the ruin, it lies in the dust.
lines.tts: Their gate still stands. In the ruin, it lies in the dust.

lines.text: The ward seals the old stair. The ruin has its own way up.
lines.tts: The ward seals the old stair. The ruin has its own way up.

lines.text: Fused shut here. For the coronation, they stood open.
lines.tts: Fused shut, here. For the coronation, they stood open.

lines.text: Here they come.
lines.tts: Here they come.

lines.text: Steady.
lines.tts: [tense] Steady...

lines.text: Not again.
lines.tts: [sighs] Not again.

lines.text: Too many of them.
lines.tts: [under her breath] Too many of them...

lines.text: Archers. Keep moving.
lines.tts: Archers! Keep moving.

lines.text: That one's not like the others.
lines.tts: [tense] That one's not like the others.

lines.text: Stay down.
lines.tts: Stay down.

lines.text: Rest now.
lines.tts: Rest now.

lines.text: Not here. Not like this.
lines.tts: [breathless] Not here... not like this.

lines.text: Keep moving.
lines.tts: [pained] Keep... moving.

lines.text: Quiet again.
lines.tts: [exhales] Quiet again.

lines.text: Rest, whoever you were.
lines.tts: Rest, whoever you were.

lines.text: That's the last of them.
lines.tts: That's... the last of them.

lines.text: The royal floor. My family lived here, above everyone they locked in.
lines.tts: The royal floor. My family lived here... above everyone they locked in.

lines.text: The Crown. Whatever he started, it's still going.
lines.tts: [quietly] The Crown. Whatever he started... it's still going.

lines.text: I can hear it. Like a heartbeat in the stone.
lines.tts: I can hear it. Like a heartbeat... in the stone.

lines.text: A warden, still keeping the gate. Not from me.
lines.tts: A warden, still keeping the gate. [firmly] Not from me.

lines.text: You held your post. It's over now.
lines.tts: You held your post. [softly] It's over now.

lines.text: His captain. Still guarding a dead king's door.
lines.tts: His captain. Still guarding a dead king's door.

lines.text: Loyal to the end. To him.
lines.tts: Loyal to the end. [bitterly] To him.

lines.text: That face — the Queen's? No. That's him.
lines.tts: [shaken] That face... the Queen's? [angry] No. That's him.

lines.text: You want my blood to finish it. You won't have it.
lines.tts: You want my blood to finish it. [determined] You won't have it.

lines.text: Let it end. All of it.
lines.tts: [determined] Let it end. All of it.

lines.text: Rest, all of you. The castle can forget now.
lines.tts: [quietly] Rest, all of you. The castle can forget now.

lines.text: Grandmother, you undersold this place.
lines.tts: Grandmother... you undersold this place.

lines.text: Someone lived here once. Laughed here, even.
lines.tts: Someone lived here once. Laughed here, even.

lines.text: I keep thinking someone's right behind me.
lines.tts: [quietly] I keep thinking someone's right behind me.

lines.text: If the walls remember, what will they remember of me?
lines.tts: If the walls remember... what will they remember of me?

lines.text: Stone, dust and ghosts. Some inheritance.
lines.tts: [sighs] Stone, dust, and ghosts. Some inheritance.

lines.text: I came all this way for a family name.
lines.tts: I came all this way for a family name.

lines.text: Every portrait up here looks at me like I stole something.
lines.tts: Every portrait up here looks at me like I stole something.

lines.text: Too quiet. I don't trust quiet in this place.
lines.tts: Too quiet. I don't trust quiet in this place.

lines.text: Standing still won't find me any answers.
lines.tts: Standing still won't find me any answers.

lines.text: Almost there. Wherever there is.
lines.tts: Almost there. [dryly] Wherever there is.

lines.text: Cold up here. Even the stone feels tired.
lines.tts: Cold up here. Even the stone feels tired.

lines.text: My blade's heavier. As if the keep is lending me its weight.
lines.tts: [quietly] My blade's heavier... as if the keep is lending me its weight.

lines.text: The castle turns when I turn now. I'll use that.
lines.tts: [low] The castle turns when I turn now... [steady] I'll use that.
